text:
AMATH 362: Mathematics of Climate Change
Description: An introduction to the mathematical description of the climate. Topics covered include solar radiation and how the Earth is heated, climate feedbacks, the role of the oceans and the Earth's rotation, climate data and climate variability, and simple models of human-climate interactions. Calculus and computation will be used throughout the course. [Offered in W of even years.]
Requirements: Prereq: One of MATH 118, 119,128, 138, 148; One of STAT 202, 206, 220, 230, 240; One of AMATH 250, 251, 350, MATH 211, 213, 218, 228
